```yaml
name: Push Manifests to OCI Registry

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

jobs:
  push-manifests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Push Kubernetes manifests to GHCR
        run: |
          # Define the OCI artifact reference
          OCI_REF="ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/manifests:x86-${{ github.sha }}"
          
          # Create a tarball of the manifests
          tar -czf manifests.tar.gz -C overlays/x86 .
          
          # Push the tarball to GHCR as an OCI artifact
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag "${OCI_REF}" \
            --annotation "org.opencontainers.image.description=Kubernetes manifests for x86 architecture" \
            --annotation "org.opencontainers.image.source=${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}" \
            --annotation "org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}" \
            "docker-archive:manifests.tar.gz"
```
